<syntaxhighlight lang="freebasic">
Function meaningoflife() As Byte
    Dim As Byte y = 42
    Return y
End Function

Sub main()
    Print "Main: The meaning of life is "; meaningoflife()
End Sub

main()
Sleep
</syntaxhighlight>
